content: TypeORM reached 1.0 (2026-05-19) after years on 0.3.x, now actively maintained; 1.1.1 latest (2026-09-01), requires Node 20.19+/22.13+/24.11+. @nestjs/typeorm 12.0.1 supports typeorm ^0.3.0 || ^1.0.0-dev. Prisma and Drizzle offer better type inference/DX and are trending for new projects, but NestJS has first-class TypeORM integration (ActiveRecord+DataMapper, decorator entities, migrations) matching this project's already-locked convention. Recommend TypeORM 1.x over 0.3.x (actively maintained line) and over switching to Prisma/Drizzle (would break established project convention with no compelling gain for this scope).
